prompt:

| Return 3m            | +0.8% |
| Return 1m            | +5.1% |
| Return 1w            | +2.0% |
| Range position (63d) | 80% |
| 21d realized vol     | 21% |
| Last close           | 92.97 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows short-term momentum (1m +5.1%, 1w +2%), but it is currently at about 80% of its 63-day range, suggesting it may face resistance and limited upside without a clear breakout. With modest longer-term return and current positioning, a cautious stance is prudent for the next 20 trading days.

DECISION: HOLD
